settings.text: Four questions, about a minute. You'll get the sleep need that suits them, the size to look for and a few in-stock beds to start with.

settings.question: How does the Sleep Match work?
settings.answer: Your answers about how your dog sleeps, anything that affects their comfort and their size are scored against our five sleep needs. The best fit wins. We only recommend beds from that collection, in-stock ones first, with your size pre-selected where the bed comes in it.

settings.question: Do I have to give my email?
settings.answer: No. Your result appears straight away on this page. It's saved on your device so product pages can show which beds match. Nothing is sent to us.

settings.question: What if two needs sound right?
settings.answer: Your result shows the runner-up too. When in doubt, a dog's biggest comfort issue (stiff joints, nerves or heat) matters more than how they sleep.
